entities.name: Metathran
entities.description: A genderless, light-blue humanoid race of blue-aligned soldiers genetically engineered by Urza to fight the Phyrexians; none survived.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer and planeswalker who created the Legacy, the Bloodline Project and the Metathran army.

entities.name: Bloodline Project
entities.description: Urza's two-phase project to breed an heir and create the Metathran army against Phyrexia.

entities.name: The Legacy
entities.description: A powerful collection of artifacts meant to be a weapon capable of killing Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader the Legacy was meant to kill.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: Contested Urza's methods openly.

entities.name: Gatha
entities.description: A researcher whose unauthorized experiments got him expelled; he continued in Keld, creating Kreig.

entities.name: Kreig
entities.description: A powerful creation of Gatha that got noticed by Phyrexia.

entities.name: Thaddeus
entities.description: A Metathran general designed to act on his own, symbiotically linked with Agnate.

entities.name: Agnate
entities.description: A Metathran general linked near-telepathically to Thaddeus.

entities.name: Sisay
entities.description: Her parents were killed in the Phyrexian strike on the Bloodline sites.

entities.name: Gerrard Capashen
entities.description: Survivor of Clan Capashen whose survival saved Urza's plans.

entities.name: Clan Capashen
entities.description: A bloodline killed in the Phyrexian preemptive strike.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders the Metathran were created to fight.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance of Dominarians the Metathran fought with.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: The crew credited with achieving victory against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The war the Metathran were created to fight.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Place where the ethics of manipulating bloodlines were questioned.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Where Gatha continued his project.

entities.name: Battle of Koilos
entities.description: Coalition victory in Terisiare in which the Metathran played a part.

entities.name: Battle of the Stronghold
entities.description: Coalition victory in Urborg in which the Metathran played a part.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Rath's Kor were said by Urza to derive from Metathran stock.

events.summary: Urza creates the Legacy, then the Bloodline Project, manipulating marriages among families strongest in white mana.
events.quote: which led to the creation of the Bloodline Project .

events.summary: Urza creates the Metathran army using genetic stock from around the world infused with magic; Barrin contests his methods and researchers quit.
events.quote: Barrin began openly contesting Urza's methods while some researchers outright quit the project

events.summary: Gatha's unauthorized experiments lead to his expulsion; he continues in Keld, creating Kreig, which Phyrexia notices.
events.quote: he continued his project in Keld , ultimately creating Kreig , which was powerful enough to get noticed by Phyrexia.

events.summary: The Phyrexians launch a preemptive strike on Bloodline sites, killing thousands including Sisay's parents and Clan Capashen.
events.quote: launched a preemptive strike against sites where the Bloodline project was taking place, killing thousands of people

events.summary: Thaddeus and Agnate are awoken first to command the Metathran troops.
events.quote: Thaddeus and Agnate were awoken first to take command of the troops

events.summary: The Metathran army helps win the battles of Koilos and the Stronghold.
events.quote: winning both the battle of Koilos in Terisiare and the battle of the Stronghold in Urborg .

events.summary: The Dominarians win thanks to the Weatherlight crew, but the Metathran race dies out with the war.
events.quote: the Metathran race died out with the war they were born to fight.

relations.quote: a humanoid species created in Urza 's Bloodline Project .
genetically engineered to be decisive, unerring, and obedient
Intended to fight the Phyrexian menace and nothing else
Barrin began openly contesting Urza's methods
he continued his project in Keld , ultimately creating Kreig
Thaddeus and Agnate had a symbiotic, near-telepathic connection to each other

relations.note: Awoken first to command the troops.
relations.quote: Thaddeus and Agnate were awoken first to take command of the troops
